items.title: PHP/USD: Philippine Peso Falls Past 62 Per Dollar on Elevated Oil Prices
items.description: The Philippine peso weakened past 62 per dollar on Friday, breaching a level some analysts had flagged as potentially prompting authorities to step in to support the currency.

items.title: Samsung Biologics to Raise $2.2 Billion to Fund PolyPeptide Deal

items.title: Goldman Says Gulf Oil Exports at Two-Thirds of Pre-War Level
items.description: Oil exports from the Persian Gulf have recovered to around two-thirds of pre-war levels, limiting the Iran war’s impact on global crude prices, according to Goldman Sachs Group Inc.
